verified_architecture.interface: React and TypeScript; Vite build served by FastAPI
verified_architecture.persistence: SQLite WAL schema 2 and local filesystem
verified_architecture.queues: Separate durable import and single analysis consumer
verified_architecture.speech: faster-whisper/CTranslate2 CPU int8; tiny.en beam 3 balanced and cached base beam 5 quality
verified_architecture.speech_windows: 30-second cores with up to two seconds of context on each side; midpoint word ownership and persisted core checkpoints
verified_architecture.editorial: Versioned local extractive/lexical/acoustic heuristics with source quotation titles, six explainable dimensions and duplicate suppression
verified_architecture.framing: Bounded OpenCV face geometry and scene changes; safe fit/manual alternatives; no active-speaker identity
verified_architecture.captions: Five professional presets, word activation when valid estimates exist, editable keywords and eight original vector pictograms
verified_architecture.rendering: FFmpeg/libass; ffprobe validates real H.264/AAC MP4s; 720p/1080p and streamed ZIP downloads
verified_architecture.safety: Windows gated worker process and default 2048 MiB Job Object limit; streaming imports in 256 KiB chunks

memory_failure.historical_observation: Saved test report records three worker allocation errors involving a 243 MiB complex128 array shaped (1, 79376, 201).
memory_failure.documented_previous_app_behavior: Historical repair report describes whole-WAV materialization before feature extraction.
memory_failure.engineering_inference: Length-scaled feature extraction under a fixed memory budget explains why long audio could exhaust worker headroom. The portfolio must not identify an upstream library defect or claim a new forensic reproduction of the old implementation.
memory_failure.current_code_observation: Bounded float32 PCM windows and resumable per-core checkpoints limit feature extraction input independently of source length.
memory_failure.budget_change: The documented repair retained the 2048 MiB worker limit rather than raising it.

remaining_limits: Selection and prompt discovery remain heuristic, not general neural multimodal understanding.
Speech mistakes, names and amounts require review; no independently established 150 ms timing accuracy.
No reliable active-speaker identification, forced alignment, diarization, stacked layouts or semantic action recognition.
Google Drive OAuth code exists; live account-backed authorization remains unverified.
YouTube URLs provide references/metadata unless the user supplies or links an authorized original; no arbitrary stream download.
Local single-user application; no demonstrated multi-tenant/public-cloud hardening.
No supported broad superiority over Vizard, OpusClip or Submagic.
commercial_status: Engineering validation only. Customers, revenue, fundraising, partnerships and product-market fit have not been established by this audit.
authorship: User-led project direction and evaluation with material AI-assisted implementation; no claim of sole manual coding or invented employment.
